items.title: Wayne Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: the thing I wrote for Doc Severinsen which actually Bill Watrous recorded with Danny Styles

ctx.x: Right. And let the players balance.

I did a concert, I’ll never forget this, I did a concert and I had a big solo in the concert. I did a concert with Tony Bennett at Carnegie Hall. And on the first half of the concert was Robert Farnum and we were doing the music from “Porgy & Bess.” And I just have to tell you the story how I ended up getting this solo because Buddy Morrow was actually the first trombone player but this thing, Buddy came across it and Buddy is a wonderful, wonderful cat but this thing for some reason came across written in the…
heard a lot of college bands. But that night with the North Texas band, and it’s a great band, it’s always fifth gear. The energy.
